top_signals.title: Russia Eyes Grain Duty Pause This Year on Ukraine Strikes
top_signals.summary: Russia is weighing a suspension of the floating export duty on wheat, barley and corn through the end of 2026 as exporters face mounting logistics problems after Ukrainian attacks disrupted shipments through the Black and Azov seas.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Commission proposes fishing opportunities for 2027 in the Baltic Sea*
top_signals.summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 24 Aug 2026 Today, the Commission adopted its proposal for the 2027 fishing opportunities for the Baltic Sea. The proposal sets the total allowable catches (TACs) and quotas for the ten EU-managed fish stocks in the Baltic Sea: Bothnian herring, central Baltic herring, Gulf of Riga herring, sprat, plaice, Main Basin salmon, Gulf of Finland salmon, western Baltic cod, eastern Baltic cod, and western Baltic herring.

top_signals.title: Lessons Learned from CISA’s Recent GitHub Leak
top_signals.summary: The Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) has issued a postmortem on a data leak in which a contractor published dozens of internal CISA credentials -- including AWS Govcloud keys -- in a public GitHub repository for almost six months before being notified by KrebsOnSecurity. Experts say the gaps identified in the agency's initial response provide important lessons that all security teams should absorb.
